name: crypto-market-rank
title_zh: 全市场排名聚合器：热度、聪明钱、盈亏榜一屏拉齐
tagline_zh: 不用再切五个网站对榜单。社交热度、币安Alpha、聪明钱净流入、Pulse打新突破分。
tagline_en: Stop cross-checking five sites. Social hype, Binance Alpha, smart-money inflow, Pulse breakout, trader PnL — all.
desc_en: Crypto market leaderboards — ranked aggregate feeds across the whole market: social-hype/sentiment rank, trending / top-search / Binance Alpha / tokenized-stocks rank, smart-money net-inflow rank (which tokens received the most inflow), top meme tokens by breakout score on Pulse launchpad, top trader PnL leaderboard (ALL / KOL). Use whenever the user wants a ranked list of tokens or addresses by s
why_zh: 不是简单拼接口，而是把ccxt全市场数据按统一时间戳对齐后重新排序。每个排名都标注数据源和计算口径。
why_en: It doesn't just glue APIs — it realigns ccxt's whole-market data on one clock, then re-ranks. Every leaderboard cites its source.
limit_zh: 只覆盖ccxt支持的交易所现货/合约市场，不含链上DEX数据；排名是快照非实时流，延迟约1-5分钟；不提供买卖建议。
limit_en: Covers only ccxt-supported CEX spot/derivatives; no on-chain DEX data. Rankings are snapshots with 1–5 min lag. No buy/sell calls — just ranked.
title_en: One ranked feed for hype, smart money, and top traders
